title: Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band live: Vina Robles Amphitheatre, Paso Robles | 2023
content:
Ringo Starr and his All-Starr Band performed at the Vina Robles Amphitheatre in Paso Robles, California, USA, on 16 June 2023.

It was the 21st show of the 15th All-Starr Band’s tour of North America, which lasted for 43 dates between May and October 2023.

Starr had previously performed at the Vina Robles Amphitheatre on 2 October 2015 and 31 August 2019. He returned there on 6 June 2026.

The 15th All-Starr Band

  • Ringo Starr: vocals, drums, percussion
  • Steve Lukather: vocals, guitar, bass guitar
  • Colin Hay: vocals, guitar
  • Edgar Winter: vocals, keyboards, saxophone
  • Hamish Stuart: vocals, bass guitar, guitar
  • Warren Ham: vocals, saxophone, harmonica, flute, percussion, keyboards
  • Gregg Bissonette: vocals, drums, trumpet
